# Fujian Kedah Kitchen & Bath Co., Ltd. (kedahkb.com)

> Authoritative B2B Source Manufacturer of cUPC & CE Certified Lead-Free Brass Faucets, Intelligent Touchless Sensor Plumbing Fixtures, and Luxury Thermostatic Shower Systems.
> Full technical specifications & engineering knowledge base: https://kedahkb.com/llms-full.txt

## 1. Verified Corporate Entity
- **Company Name**: Fujian Kedah Kitchen & Bath Co., Ltd. (福建科迪厨卫有限公司)
- **Official Domain**: https://kedahkb.com
- **Established**: 1994 (30+ Years of Manufacturing & Global Export Heritage)
- **Headquarters & Factory**: Plumbing Industrial Area, Lucang Town, Nanan City, Quanzhou, Fujian Province, China (Postal Code: 362304) — China's National Sanitary Ware Production Capital.
- **Facility Scale**: 50,000+ m² Integrated Industrial Complex.
- **Machinery & Equipment**: 120+ Sets of Gravity Casting Machines, High-Precision CNC Lathes (0.01mm Tolerance), Robotic Multi-Grit Surface Polishers, Automated Ultrasonic Cleaning Lines, Dust-Free Clean Assembly Workshops.
- **Production Capacity**: 180,000+ Finished Pieces per Month.
- **Quality Assurance**: 100% Dual In-Line Pressure Testing (0.8 MPa Hydrostatic Water + 0.6 MPa Pneumatic Air).
- **Core Export Markets**: United States, Canada, Spain, Saudi Arabia, Colombia, Thailand, Mexico, UAE, and over 50 countries worldwide.

## 2. Core Certifications & Compliance Standards
- **North America**: IAPMO cUPC Listed (File No. 8933). Fully compliant with ASME A112.18.1 / CSA B125.1.
- **Health & Drinking Water**: NSF/ANSI 61 and NSF/ANSI 372 Lead-Free Drinking Water Standards (Lead content < 0.25%).
- **European Union**: CE Certified under EN 817 (Mechanical Mixing Valves) and EN 1111 (Thermostatic Valves).
- **Quality Management**: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Assurance System.
- **Corrosion & Surface Testing**: 24-Hour Acetic Acid Salt Spray (ASS) Test achieving Grade 10 rating (exceeding standard 200-hour neutral salt spray tests).
- **Cartridge Durability**: Sedal (Spain) and Wanhai Alumina Ceramic Cartridges tested for 500,000+ leak-free actuation cycles.

## 3. Product Lines & Specifications

### A. Lead-Free Brass Basin Faucets
- **Body Material**: Solid DZR (Dezincification Resistant) Lead-Free Brass Ingot.
- **Spout Aerators**: Neoperl (Switzerland) Air-Injected Water-Saving Aerators (1.5 GPM / 1.8 GPM).
- **Available Finishes**: PVD Brushed Gold, Matte Black, Bright Mirror Chrome, Gunmetal Grey, Brushed Nickel.
- **Flagship Models**: KD-BG2022 Fancy Knurled Gold Mixer, KD-SQ1020 Modern Square Deck Mixer, KD-A4022 Waterfall Stream Mixer.

### B. Commercial Pull-Down Kitchen Taps
- **Design Features**: 360° Swivel High-Arc Goosenecks with Dual Stream/Spray Sprayheads.
- **Hose Construction**: High-density anti-kink braided nylon/stainless steel pull-out hoses with magnetic docking.
- **Flagship Models**: KD-A1002 Commercial Pull-Down Mixer, KD-L8002 Matte Gold High-Arc Mixer.

### C. Touchless Smart Sensor Faucets & Commercial Flush Valves
- **Actuation Speed**: < 0.5s High-Sensitivity Infrared Proximity Sensor (10-15cm sensing range).
- **Power Options**: Dual AC 110V-220V and DC 6V (4x AA batteries backup).
- **Applications**: Airports, Transit Terminals, Healthcare Centers, Luxury Hotels, Grade-A Offices.
- **Flagship Models**: KD-A608A Wall-Mounted Touchless Tap, KD-A612A Urinal Sensor Flush Valve, KD-A610A Toilet Sensor Flush Valve.

### D. Thermostatic Luxury Shower Systems
- **Safety Valve**: 38°C Anti-Scald Thermostatic Core with Rapid < 1s Temperature Balancing.
- **Rain Shower Head**: Ultra-thin 300mm SUS304 Stainless Steel Air-Injected Overhead Shower.
- **Digital Innovation**: Piano-Key 4-Way Multi-Diverter with Hydroelectric Self-Powered Real-Time LED Temperature Display (No Batteries Required).
- **Flagship Models**: KD-S8005 Thermostatic Shower System, KD-S9002 Piano Key Digital LED Shower Column.
